def transform_v2(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    background=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects=[(color,cells,_bbox(cells)) for color,cells in _components(grid) if color!=background]
    markers=[(obj,_corner(obj[1])) for obj in objects]
    markers=[(obj,corner) for obj,corner in markers if corner is not None]
    if not markers: return out
    (marker_color,marker_cells,marker_box),corner=max(markers,key=lambda x:len(x[0][1]))
    inside=[obj for obj in objects if obj[1]!=marker_cells and _inside(obj[2],marker_box)]
    outside=[obj for obj in objects if obj[1]!=marker_cells and _disjoint(obj[2],marker_box)]
    targets=set()
    for source_color,source_cells,source_box in inside:
        pattern=_shape(source_cells)
        matches=[obj for obj in outside if _shape(obj[1])==pattern]
        if len(matches)==1:
            targets.update(matches[0][1])
    for r,c in targets: out[r][c]=marker_color
    return out
